verdict.rationale: Turn-taking is a fair axis for a voice-agent platform like Bolna, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions end-of-turn detection, endpointing, VAD settings, or semantic turn models. The speech-to-speech model option and mid-call language detection are different capabilities and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use model-based end-of-turn detection beyond simple VAD silence timeouts so the agent doesn't talk over slow speakers
